cases.source: In the ever-evolving landscape of interface design, our exploratory comparison offers a comprehensive contribution. Among 18 volunteers, the estimated difference was 2.4 ms (95% CI: -0.8 to 5.6 ms) [2]. Assignment was observational, so this association does not establish a causal effect. The result may not apply to outdoor use.
